scope: Read-only audit of routed.dcp DSP48E1 dynamic OPMODE DPREG-4 warning. No synthesis, implementation, RTL, production-script, or bitstream modifications.

source.coverage_note: The warning cell belongs to the shared legacy hardware requantizer (har_npu_core.sv line 132). RAW mode gates the hidden-output quant() update off at line 267 (if quant_value_valid_q && !raw_mode_q). Both the planned 100-round RAW test and the planned 12-round trained engineering-model test use RAW FC1; the latter executes ReLU, quantization, and the final layer on the on-chip CPU. Neither validates the legacy hardware requantizer result path. Only a dedicated legacy HAR non-RAW execution would exercise that result path. No such legacy-path physical coverage is claimed by this audit.

pin_proof.xy_driver: p_0_out__1_i_40 LUT2 INIT=4'h1; exact same I0/I1 as _i_39
pin_proof.symbolic: s = OR(shift[4:0]); t = NOT s; OPMODE[6:0] = {0,s,s,0,t,0,t}

official_spec.title: AMD/Xilinx UG479 v1.10 (March 27, 2018), page 34, Tables 2-7 and 2-9

z_selections.100: P for MACC extend; requires X=00,Y=10 and PREG=1
z_selections.110: P arithmetic shift right 17; requires PREG=1

official_spec.local_unisim_note: 2019.1 unisim casex implements Z=11x as shifted P; the normative table marks 111 illegal. Neither 110 nor 111 is reachable here.

conclusion.status: No logically selectable internal P feedback in actual routed OPMODE cone
conclusion.detail: The only stable Boolean OPMODE values are 0000101 (Z=0, X/Y select multiplication) and 0110000 (Z=C, X=Y=0). Z=010/100/110 and X=10 are unreachable for every input pattern. DPREG-4 is conservative with respect to correlated dynamic pins in this checkpoint.
limitations: This proves routed-netlist Boolean mode reachability; no post-route SDF timing simulation, analog/internal mux transition-skew analysis, or additional PVT qualification was performed.
This audit is not a substitute for STA or physical-board functional tests. RTL simulation passing does not remove physical DRC warnings.
The audit does not certify every DRC warning. CFGBVS-1, pipeline/reset recommendations, and unused DMI response nets remain as reported.

At this audit correction, the planned RAW 100-round and RAW-plus-on-chip-CPU 12-round physical-board tests are not_performed. The parent task reports the internal FPGA TAP remains all zero and testing has not begun. This is parent-reported test state, not a hardware observation by this audit agent.
